## Summary

Describe the change and the module or docs area it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] Build or tests run locally
- [ ] Canonical skills and stable public guides updated, if needed
- [ ] XML documentation updated for public APIs, if needed
- [ ] PR title or squash commit follows Conventional Commit format, if release-note relevant
- [ ] No unrelated changes included

## Knowledge impact

List the owning `monica-infra-*` skills updated with this change. If affected
implementation needs no knowledge change, explain it on its own line using
`Knowledge-Impact: none — <concrete reason>`. The Knowledge Impact check reads
that explanation and the catalog's source ownership map.

## Notes

Mention breaking changes, migration notes, or follow-up work.
